[b]FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions):[/b] [spoiler][b][color=#f4cccc]Question: The mod is not loading for some reason, how do I fix it? (v1.5.6)[/color]
[/b][b]Answer: Make sure you have installed it properly. Install the [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19723]original mod[/url][b] first then replace/overwrite some of its files with this translation. [/b][i]Also make sure to install all of its other depencies as listed on the original mod page.[/i]

[b][color=#f4cccc][i]Question: The mod is not loading for some reason, how do I fix it? I am using the R-18 version. [/i][b][color=#f4cccc](v1.5.6)[/color][/b][/color]
[/b][b]Answer: Make sure you have installed it properly. Install the [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19723]original mod[/url][b] first then replace/overwrite some of its files with the sfw files first and then the r-18 files after. [/b][i]Also make sure to install all of its other depencies as listed on the original mod page.[/i]

[b][color=#f4cccc]Question: I am using the R-18 version, the mod worked fine but Amon's dialogues are blank, [b][color=#f4cccc]how do I fix it? [b][color=#f4cccc](v1.5.6)[/color][/b][/color][/b][/color]
[/b][b]Answer: Install it properly by downloading the SFW version first, replace the original files with the sfw translation, and then do the same with the R-18 ver.[/b]

[color=#f4cccc][b]Question: Why is Amon non-marriageable even though the mod description said he was[/b][color=#f4cccc][b]? [/b]or [b]Why can't I marry Amon?[/b][/color][/color]
[b]Answer: Get him to 8 hearts or above and trigger his 8-heart Event. Accept his ___ and he should be marriageable after that.[/b]

[color=#f4cccc][b]Question: 5-heart Event won't trigger, how do I get it to trigger?[/b][/color]
[b]Answer: Make sure you have already seen the 3-heart Event and read the "Seventh Letter" from your mailbox. [/b]You will get the 7th letter by first reading the 1st letter, then 2nd, then 3rd, up until you get to the 7th. You will get the 1st letter after triggering the 3-heart Event. Each letter will be sent in 1-2 in-game days.

[color=#f4cccc][b]Question: My game is bugged and it won't give me the First Letter[/b][/color]
[b]Answer: Make sure you have already triggered the 3-heart Event and waited for at least 1-2 in-game days. [/b]If none of these worked out, type in your SMAPI terminal "debug mft Hazel_first_letter". doing this command will make the letter appear on your mail tomorrow.[/spoiler]

[list]
[*]A new romanceable male NPC (locked initially, must progress through heart events)
[*]300+ dialogues. New set of dialogues for each friendship level ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8284]Miss Coriel's Unique Courtship Response CORE[/url]﻿ is Required for this)
[*]17 Heart Events: 0, 2, 3, 5, 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12.1, 12.2,13, 14
[*]2 R-18 Heart Events: 12.3, 13.2
[*][s]Two different portait types that you can switch with using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/s]
[*]Complete pre-marriage and post-marriage dialogue and interactions, including an exclusive spouse room.
[/list]
